tables.Name: private.member_trusted_devices
tables.Purpose: Stores one registered browser public key per member account; separate from administrator trust and attendance phone pairing.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the member account. A trusted-device primary key permits at most one registered browser per account.

Columns.Name: device_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the browser key; no foreign key or hardware identity is implied.

Columns.Name: public_key
Columns.Description: Stores the public ECDSA P-256 JWK. The private signing key remains in browser IndexedDB.

Columns.Name: device_label
Columns.Description: Stores a reported browser label, not verified hardware identity.

Columns.Name: registered_at
Columns.Description: Records browser enrollment time.

Columns.Name: last_seen_at
Columns.Description: Records the recent dashboard heartbeat used to select an available approving browser.

tables.Name: private.member_device_sessions
tables.Purpose: Binds an Auth session to a browser signing challenge and authorization boundary.

Columns.Name: session_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the Auth session awaiting or holding browser authorization.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the member account. A trusted-device primary key permits at most one registered browser per account.

Columns.Name: device_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the browser key; no foreign key or hardware identity is implied.

Columns.Name: public_key
Columns.Description: Stores the public ECDSA P-256 JWK. The private signing key remains in browser IndexedDB.

Columns.Name: challenge
Columns.Description: Stores the session-bound signing message. Successful verification consumes it.

Columns.Name: challenge_expires_at
Columns.Description: Bounds the signing challenge; the creating function uses a ten-minute window.

Columns.Name: authorized_until
Columns.Description: Remains null before authorization and bounds the authorized member session.

tables.Name: private.member_device_approvals
tables.Purpose: Stores session-bound requests to replace a member browser, including approval, denial and consumption.

Columns.Name: id
Columns.Description: Identifies this browser-replacement approval request.

Columns.Name: user_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the member account. A trusted-device primary key permits at most one registered browser per account.

Columns.Name: requesting_session_id
Columns.Description: Binds the request to one Auth session; this column must be unique.

Columns.Name: approver_session_id
Columns.Description: Records the deciding Auth session. Session deletion clears attribution while preserving the request.

Columns.Name: device_id
Columns.Description: Identifies the browser key; no foreign key or hardware identity is implied.

Columns.Name: device_label
Columns.Description: Stores a reported browser label, not verified hardware identity.

Columns.Name: status
Columns.Description: Stores pending, approved, denied, or consumed. Expiration is derived from timestamps.
Columns.Extra: Default 'pending'. CHECK pending, approved, denied, or consumed.

Columns.Name: requested_at
Columns.Description: Records request creation.

Columns.Name: expires_at
Columns.Description: Limits the approval request to two minutes by default.

Columns.Name: decided_at
Columns.Description: Records the approval or denial time when present.
